links.plain: skin warmth sensors registering the 10-minute warm shower
links.function: relays cutaneous warmth signals from skin thermoreceptors inward toward subcortical centers
links.narration_bridge: Tracks cutaneous temperature sensing in Raymann, Swaab & Van Someren (2008, Brain, SRC5).

links.plain: preoptic thermostat opening hand-and-foot vessels to drop core heat and start sleep
links.function: commands peripheral vasodilation to shed ~1°F of core heat while firing sleep-promoting GABAergic neurons
links.narration_bridge: Directly mapped in Harding, Franks & Wisden (2018, Current Biology, SRC3; 2019, SRC6).

links.plain: deep slow-wave generator locking into steady early-night recovery
links.function: stabilizes slow-wave NREM oscillations once core temperature glides downward
links.narration_bridge: Explains enhanced slow-wave sleep stability in Dorsey et al. (1996, SRC7) and Raymann et al. (2008, SRC5).
